purpose: A person as a picture or their initials, on a colour derived from their name, with a presence dot and an overflow count for groups.

supplied: the image falls back to initials, and initials to a generic icon, so there is never a broken image
the colour is derived from the name, which makes it stable rather than meaningful — it is never the only signal
a decorative avatar is hidden from assistive technology instead of announcing a name twice
the presence status is given as text, not only as a coloured dot
required: `name` for the accessible label, or `decorative` when the name is already beside it
`alt`-worthy `label` text where the avatar stands alone as a link to a person

composition.notes: AvatarGroup takes Avatar children and collapses the overflow past `max`.

safeMutations.rationale: Shape and size are presentation; the person and their presence are data.

propNotes.decorative: Hides it from assistive technology. Correct when the name is already adjacent in text.
